initialFailureResolution: Both failures expected a public false event during destruction. Existing Canvas native-PiP test and Document PiP lifecycle contract suppress post-destroy events. Corrected expected sequence only; retained original reports and all cleanup assertions. No production change.
limitations: Six WebKit cases per PiP run report API unavailability, not native playback success
Two sequential native windows per live player; not repeated player mounting or background/physical-device performance evidence
Source PiP pass predates the extra visible-text assertion and screenshot; main and legacy include both
Mask source regression uses actual model with CSS web fullscreen; not OS fullscreen, GPU/WASM closure or full distribution proof
Old published Danmuku combinations, OS fullscreen, complete installation distribution and final performance comparison remain in task 08/09
